name: sprocket_520_45t
description: Aluminium 7075-T6 motorcycle rear sprocket for a 520 chain — hub pilot bore, five-bolt circle, lightening windows, stamped teeth.

stages.prompt:
Aluminium motorcycle rear sprocket (7075-T6) for a 520 chain, fully parametric — a flat 6 mm plate part like the real stamped/machined part.

Frame: the sprocket plate lies on the XY plane (bottom face at z = 0), centred on the origin in X and Y. Plate thickness 6 mm. mm units.

- Teeth: 45 identical evenly spaced teeth around the rim (angular pitch 8 degrees). Tooth band root at r ~= 109, tips at r ~= 118 -> outer diameter ~236 mm (PCD 227.6 for the 520 chain: pitch 15.875, roller 10.16). Teeth ~9 mm tall, trapezoidal, tips a bit narrower than the gaps — the usual stamped-sprocket profile; no exact roller-seat geometry needed.
- Web: solid plate from the centre out to the tooth band root.
- Centre pilot bore dia 76 mm through Z at the origin (hub locating bore).
- Five M10 mounting holes dia 10.5 mm on a bolt circle of dia 100 mm, every 72 degrees, first hole on the +X axis.
- Five identical lightening windows between the bolt-hole axes (offset 36 degrees): rounded capsule/trapezoid openings ~40 mm in the radial direction x ~26 mm wide, centred at r ~= 79 mm; all corners fully rounded (radius >= 8 mm); webs to bore, bolt holes and tooth band >= 6 mm.
- Rim edges broken with a ~0.5 mm chamfer.
Expose tooth count, plate thickness, pilot bore, bolt-circle PCD and window count as named parameters.
